en.title: PMS 10.2.1(2)(b)(d): capital deduction of 'defined benefit pension fund assets of the Insurance Intermediary'
en.summary: PMS 10.2.1(2)(b) lists deductions from the capital of a Money Service Provider. Item d) deducts "defined benefit pension fund assets of the Insurance Intermediary" - wording taken from the rules for insurance intermediaries. The other items refer to the Money Services Provider. Item h) (assets not readily realisable) probably captures such assets anyway.
en.correction: Please read "defined benefit pension fund assets of the Money Services Provider" in item d).
